What do you feel the most proud of?
As a teacher I am always proud of the fact that I always put my students first, and that I always want to give them the best lesson I can. As a father, I am proud of my daughter 100%.

My senior year of high school I had an English teacher tell me that I would be better off not going to college because I would be wasting everyone's time and money. I'm a junior now studying criminology and I'm making a constant GPA of around 3.4. I'm proud to know that I can do it.

But part of me feels like I'm doing it just to spite her.

The fact that despite how bad the past couple of years have been for me in terms of health (mostly mental), I've still managed to have perfect attendance in school for 4 years straight and recently received a certificate for a distinction (90-100% grade overall) in the year I just finished.

Also... The fact that I put others first but don't let negative peer pressure (i.e. people wanting me to smoke, people telling me every single day that I need to wear make up) affect me is something I'm very proud of too.
My children. I'm proud with how they are turning out, and how they have changed my life.

That I managed to maintain my sanity and 4.0+ GPA last year.

I'm also proud that I have improved so much, art-wise, over the past few years. My drawings and paintings have turned from crap to not-an-eyesore.
I'm proud of having all my shit under control after several hard years of scrambling to keep my shit from falling apart.
